NESTING_AUDIT.why_it_matters: multilevel partial pooling can leak across folds if the pooling variance is tuned on all countries. It was not. Stated explicitly because it is the first thing an opponent checks when the result is against us, and the first thing a quant checks when it is for us.

ESTIMATION_NOT_DATA.finding: MrsP with 3 census covariates (0.0856) beats MrsP with WDI GDP/urban/tertiary added (0.0903)
ESTIMATION_NOT_DATA.reading: the binding constraint on cross-sectional accuracy is ESTIMATION, not data. Third independent confirmation: (1) the injected 5-variable set overfit ~60 country rows, (2) nested-alpha ridge tuning moved little, (3) now extra covariates cost 0.47pp.
ESTIMATION_NOT_DATA.consequence: Hofstede/Inglehart may carry less than their attributed ablation margin; regularization quality matters more than adding channels.
